up: For the assay with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1614428', retrieve all activity records that have exact activity values (i.e., standard_relation = '=' and standard_value is not null) along with the chemical structures of the tested compounds. Include the following columns: assay_chembl_id (the ChEMBL ID of the assay), compound_chembl_id (the ChEMBL ID of the molecule), activity_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, pchembl_value, and canonical_smiles (the SMILES representation of the compound). The data should be ordered by activity_id. Ensure the results are connected through the appropriate joins: activities to assays (using assay_id), activities to compound_records (using record_id), compound_records to molecule_dictionary (using molregno), and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures (using molregno).
sql: SELECT assays.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, activities.activity_id, activities.standard_type, activities.standard_relation, activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units, activities.pchembl_value, compound_structures.canonical_smiles FROM activities INNER JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id INNER JOIN compound_records ON activities.record_id = compound_records.record_id INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary ON compound_records.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno INNER JOIN compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno WHERE assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614428' AND activities.standard_relation = '=' AND activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY activities.activity_id;
